title: FCR-N, FCR-D up and FCR-D down capacity prices of the joint Swedish-DK2 auctions (hourly).
transformation_notes: One row per delivery hour, zone (DK2, SE3, SE4), product (fcr_n symmetric, fcr_d_up, fcr_d_down) and auction (early = 'D-1 early', former D-2; late = 'D-1 late', former D-1; total = volume-weighted average of the two marginal prices, as published).
price_eur_per_mw_h = PriceTotalEUR (EUR per MW and hour). From 2024-02-01 it is the marginal (pay-as-cleared) price of each auction; before that the published value is an average price.
volume_local_mw = PurchasedVolumeLocal (procured in the zone), volume_total_mw = PurchasedVolumeTotal.
The documented DST-2024 labelling error (HourUTC 2024-10-27 01:00 and 01:01) is repaired, see validation.dst_label_rows_repaired.
note: Test fixture sliced from data/public/nordic/fcr_nordic.parquet by scripts/research/nordic_make_fixtures.py
